header_sentences: See Charity, Grape, and Spiritual good.

contexts.text: They are called sheep who are endowed with the good of charity, that is, with good spiritual and natural.
Therefore the good of charity precedes, and the truth of charity follows.
When this ground is prepared in the intellectual mind, the good of charity is insinuated by the Lord...
All the good of charity which he does is of the Lord alone, not through the will, but through conscience...
That there now appeared with the man of the Ancient Church a little of the truth of faith from the good of charity. Signified.
See Clay.
To do the good of charity. Signified.
Priest = the good of charity.
Peter, James, and John = faith, charity, and the good of charity.
In the good of charity with man there are more things than a man can ever believe; there are in it all things of his faith...
That they were averse to the goods of charity. Signified.
In his intellectual part the Lord implants the good of charity, and through this a new will...
Good... is also predicated of all who are in the good of charity, and are at the same time in ignorance of truth...
(The little children) are thus introduced into the goods of charity...
See Lot (the man).
The states of those within the Church who are against the good of charity. Treated of. AC 2315, Enumerated.
Being among the evil, but separate from them, as is the case with the men of the Church who are in the good of charity. Signified.
That those within the Church who are in the good of charity acknowledge the Divine Human and the Holy proceeding... but not those who are not in the good of charity. Signified.
It is impossible for those who are not in the good of charity to believe that (all regeneration is from the Lord)... for the good of charity is the very ground of the seeds of faith...
Here is described the first state of those within the Church who are against the good of charity, and consequently against the Lord; for the one involves the other...
That everyone will be judged according to the good of charity, and not according to the truth of faith, when this is separated from good. Signified.
Lest they should do violence to the good of charity. Signified, Explained. AC 2370.

It does not treat here of those who falsify the good of charity, by explaining it in favour of self... but of those who do not want to hear anything about the goods of charity or of good works, but only about faith separated therefrom...
Dinner, supper, feast = the good of charity, in which is the cohabitation of the Lord with man.
That they would reject the good of charity more than the Lord's Divine Human and Holy proceeding. Signified, Explained. AC 2375. AC 2382.
That the Lord protects those who are in the good of charity. Signified, Explained.

Man... scarcely knows whether he is in the good of charity or not... But... all are in the good of charity who have conscience... and who thence think well about the neighbour, and will well to him, even if he is an enemy, and this without any recompense...
That all who are in the good of charity, and all things of it, will be saved. Signified, Explained.
Doubt whether he could have the good of charity; that is, could think and act from this good. Signified, Explained.
But they who are in the good of charity do all things with discrimination; for they are in light...
The good of the Rational is conceived by the influx of Divine good into that truth, which then becomes the good of charity itself, which is the brother of faith.
The garments of salvation = the truths of faith; the robe of justice = the good of charity.
As the truth of faith is inseparable from the good of charity...
The external man does not domineer over the internal... only with those who are in the good of charity; that is, who suffer themselves to be led by the Lord.
Exploration concerning the good of charity. Signified, Explained.
But when these evils are removed, the works become good, and are goods of charity...
The natural good of truth is not spiritual good, that is, the good of faith and the good of charity, until it is reformed.
That the good of charity shall give truth. Signified.
The goods of charity are such truths...
That those who are in the good of charity are not to betake themselves to the doctrinal things of faith. Signified.
These truths are the goods of charity themselves, which are called spiritual goods, and make the Spiritual Church...
Good is not the good of charity until truths have been implanted in it; and such as are the truths implanted in it, such does the good become...
If a man were to think from the goods of charity, he would then clearly see that the truths of faith are in the second place... for the good of charity is like a flame, which affords light...
To believe is internal, and is impossible except... to those who are in the good of charity towards the neighbour.
Interior truth in its essence is nothing but the good of charity. Treated of.
That they had not the good of charity in their truths. Signified.
That they had the good of charity and of love in their truths. Signified.
The reception of this influx (of the Divine which causes happiness) is impossible with anyone who has not lived the life of faith; that is, who has not been in the good of charity.
When the colour scarlet appears in the other life, it = spiritual good; that is, the good of charity towards the neighbour.
Anger recession from the good of charity.
The man of the Celestial Church was regenerated as to the voluntary part, from infancy imbuing the good of charity...
The internal goods of charity are grapes; and the external ones are figs.
Scientifics which are receptible of the good of charity. Signified.
The goods of charity, or goods of life. Signified.
He has faith when he is in the good of charity; for then, from the good of charity, as from a flame, truths... are enlightened.
Under Brother, see this reference.

The good of charity from the will, thus from affection, is internal good, or the good of the Internal Church; but the good of charity not from affection, but from obedience; and not from the will, but from what is doctrinal, is external good, or the good of the External Church.
The good of charity is attended with this, that everything of wisdom is appropriated to it...
It is the good of charity towards the neighbour which conjoins (the Celestial and Spiritual Kingdoms). Explained.
The truths of celestial good, which are the goods of charity. Signified.
When the Angels are talking about... the interior goods of charity, flocks (appear); and when of the exterior ones, herds.
Thus the influx of the good of charity and of the truth of faith. Signified. AC 6154.
The good of the Church which is represented by Manasseh is the good of charity, which is insinuated by the Lord into the man of the Church through the truths of faith...
In the internal of the Church are those who are in the good of charity, which is the good of faith, also the good of truth, and also spiritual good, which are Israel...
Vivification through the good of charity and the truth of faith. Signified.
The good of charity with the celestial man is what is called... celestial truth.
That from a depraved will they had utterly debilitated the external good of charity. Signified.
Grapes, in the relative sense, = the good of charity.
Contempt from those who are in the good of charity. Signified.
They rejected the good of charity far behind the truth of faith...
The good of charity is the internal of the Spiritual Kingdom.
The good of mutual love is more interior than the good of charity towards the neighbour; for the former is from the Rational, but the latter is from the Natural...

In order to distinguish between the external good of the Celestial Church and the internal good of the Spiritual Church, we may in future call the former good the good of mutual love, and the latter the good of charity towards the neighbour, which distinction has not been observed in what precedes.
That the Spiritual Kingdom shall come above the good of charity even to the good of mutual love... Signified.
Where the Spiritual Kingdom is treated of, mountains = the good of charity towards the neighbour, which is the internal of that Kingdom; and hills = the truth of faith, which is the external of it.
Hence it was evident how difficult it is to live the life of faith unless one has lived in the good of charity.
Genuine trust is not possible with any but those who are in the good of charity; and genuine hope with any but those who are in the good of faith.
(Thus) the internal of the Church is the good of charity in the will; and therefore when this ceases, the Church itself ceases; for the good of charity is the essential of it.
They acknowledged as men of the Church all who lived in the good of charity... AC 6637. AC 6637:2.
(Thus) the truth of faith without the good of charity cannot produce anything, nor the good of charity without the truth of faith; there must be a conjunction of both to produce fruits...
The total falsification of the good of charity and of the truth of faith. Signified.
Jerusalem = the Spiritual Church, thus the good of that love, which is the good of charity and thence of faith.

The Spiritual Church... is internal and external; and those are in the Internal Church who are in the good of charity; and those are in the External Church who are in the good of faith. Those who are in the good of charity are they who from charity towards the neighbour see the truths which are of faith; but those who are in the good of faith are they who from faith regard charity, thus who do good not from the affection of charity, but from the obedience of faith; that is, because it is so commanded. It is the latter who are here properly represented by the sons of Israel; for these are they who in the other life are infested by those who are in falsities; for they who are in the affection of charity cannot be so infested, because the Spirits who are in falsities and evils cannot approach those who are in this good, because the Lord is in this good. If the latter are infested, it is done only as to the fallacies and appearances through which they have believed that to be truth which is not truth... These in the other life willingly reject falsities, and receive truths; because the good of charity is the recipient of truth, because it loves it and longs for it.

As to the conjunction of the good of charity and the truth of faith in a man, the case is this. The good of charity enters through the soul into man, and the truth of faith enters through the hearing; the former inflows immediately from the Lord, the latter mediately through the Word; hence the way through which the good of charity enters is called an internal way; and the way through which the truth of faith enters is called an external Way; that which enters through an internal way is not perceived, because it does not fall manifestly into the sense; but that which enters through an external way is perceived, because it falls manifestly into the sense; hence it is that everything of the Church is attributed to faith. It is otherwise with those who are regenerate; with these the good of charity is manifestly perceived. AC 9224:2, Explained. AC 9227:2.

The conjunction of the good of charity with the truth of faith is effected in the interiors of man; the good itself which inflows from the Lord, there adopts truth, and appropriates it to itself, and thus causes that with the man good is good and truth truth... Without this conjunction, charity... is only natural goodness, and faith... is only knowledge...
The good of charity receives its quality from the abundance of the truths of faith; and also from the connection of one truth with another. Thus is formed spiritual good with a man.

They who are in the good of charity and of faith look above themselves, because they are elevated by the Lord; but they who are not in the good of charity and of faith look below themselves, because they are not elevated by the Lord. Explained.

When man is being regenerated, he is led through faith in the understanding... to faith in the will... that is, through the truth of faith to the good of charity; and when the man is in the good of charity, he is regenerate; and then from this good he begets truths, which are called the truths of good...
The affection of good, thus the good of charity. Signified.
Under Philistine, see this reference.
Heaven, where is the good of charity. Signified. AC 8330:2.
When the good of charity is to be insinuated, which makes the spiritual life, the delight of pleasures is removed, which had made the natural life. Treated of.
After regeneration, the good of charity becomes everything of life...

This bread (the manna) = the good of charity which is begotten through the truth of faith; before regeneration this good is utterly unknown to man... When yet this good immensely transcends the delights of the loves of self and of the world...
He who acts from the truth of faith is not yet in the order of Heaven; but he who acts from the good of charity is in the order. Explained.
Through temptations the truths of faith... are conjoined with the good of charity.
Conjunction of truth Divine with the good of charity, and influx thence. Signified, Explained.
The good of the Spiritual Church is the good of truth; this good is also the good of charity.
It treats in () of those who injure or destroy the truth of faith or the good of charity in themselves or others...

These arcana... can be apprehended only by those who are in the good of charity, but not by those who are in the truths of faith without this good. The reason is, that they who are in the good of charity are in the light of Heaven, and from that light they see the things which are in the light of the world; whereas they who are in the truth of faith and not in the good of charity are in the light of the world...
This is why he who acts from the good of charity is the true man of the Spiritual Church...
For the Spiritual itself is the good of charity.
Communication with Heaven, and through Heaven, is effected through the good of charity and of love... Signified.
The truths themselves therein are called the truths of faith; and the good is called the good of charity.
As the good of charity makes the new will, it also makes conscience.

It treats in () of the injuries done in various ways to the truth of faith and the good of charity; and of the amendment and restoration of them... Finally, of the state of life of man when he is in the good of charity.
Under Flesh, see this reference.

The man of the Church would then see... that the Lord Himself has spoken many things about the good of charity; and that it is the principal of the Church... The good of charity is to do good from willing good.

The good which a man does in the second state of regeneration, when he is regenerate, is called the good of charity; and therefore when a man... does good from the good of charity, he does good from affection.
No affirmation of such things as are against the good of charity. Signified.
The good of charity towards the neighbour is exterior good, which is signified by just; and the good of love to the Lord is interior good, which is signified by innocent.
Sheep = those who are in the good of charity from the Lord. AC 9391.
Conjunction through the good of charity with those who are in few truths. Signified, Explained.
There are three kinds of men who constitute the Church; they who are in the good of charity constitute the internal of the Church...

The conjunction of Heaven with the human race... is effected through those who are in the good of charity, thus through the good of charity; for in it the Lord is present; for the Lord is that good itself, because it proceeds from Him. Through this good the Lord conjoins Himself with those who are in the affection of truth...

By the man of the Church is meant he who is in the good of charity and thence in the truths of faith from the Lord... for the Lord inflows into this good... and through it into the affection of truth...
Vineyard = ... spiritual good, which is the good of charity towards the neighbour; for this good makes the Spiritual Church.
Then the truths of faith are implanted in the good of charity; and finally this good itself is implanted; and then the man is regenerate...
Then this good is the good of charity.
In the Middle Heaven reigns the good of charity towards the neighbour.
The internal of the Spiritual Kingdom is the good of charity towards the neighbour; and the external is the good of obedience from faith. AC 9741:3. AC 9870. AC 9873.
Spiritual heat is the good of charity; and spiritual light is the truth of faith.

The internal good in the good of faith is the good of charity, which is spiritual good; and the internal good in the good of charity is the good of mutual love, which is the external celestial good...
The second degree is opened through a life according to the truths of faith from the Word, and according to the goods of charity towards the neighbour thence.
The good of charity towards the neighbour makes the Middle Heaven.
The good of charity towards the neighbour is the internal in the Middle Heaven; and the good of faith in the Lord is the external good there.
In the Middle Heaven there is conjunction with the Lord through faith implanted in the good of charity towards the neighbour.

They who are in the good of charity towards the neighbour also receive (the influx of the Lord), but more remotely; because the good of charity towards the neighbour is more remote than the good of love to the Lord.
Truth is apperceived as good when it comes from the understanding into the will; this good is the good of charity towards the neighbour, and is called spiritual good.
From the good of charity and of faith. Signified. For in the Middle Heaven reigns the good of charity towards the neighbour; and in the Ultimate Heaven the good of faith.
Lastly () treats of the good of charity, through which the Spiritual Heaven is illuminated in the truths of faith by the Lord.
See Good of Love. AC 10129:10.
Let them take for thee the oil of olive = the good of charity and of faith. Explained.
Wine = the good of charity and of faith.
Divine spiritual good, which makes the Middle Heaven, is the good of charity towards the neighbour.
The good of charity and of faith. Signified. AC 9834.

It is the good of mutual love which inflows into the internal good of the Spiritual Kingdom, which is signified by the robe: from this exists its good, which is the good of charity towards the neighbour... The good of charity towards the neighbour proceeds from the good of mutual love... (for) unless the good of charity has in it the good of innocence, it is not the good of charity. References.
The robe = Divine truth in an internal form in the Spiritual Kingdom, which is the same as the good of charity.
The Spiritual is the good of charity towards the neighbour; and the Natural thence is the good of faith...
Rams = the goods of charity.

In proportion as a man is purified from evils and falsities, the truths of faith... are conjoined with the good of charity; and in the same proportion the man afterwards acts from the good of charity.
The breast = the good of charity... Explained.
As the breast, from its correspondence, = the good of charity; and the good of charity is to do good from will; therefore John, who represents this good, lay on the Lord's breast...
James = charity; and John, works, or the goods of charity. Illustrated.
(Thus) the Lord is in the good of charity, and is this good, even unknown to those who are in this good. Signified.
Angelic life consists in performing goods of charity, which are uses. HH 404:end.
The delights of good are what are called the goods of charity.
Uses are the goods which are called the goods of charity.
That a man is not interiorly admitted into the truths of faith, and into the goods of charity, except in so far as he can be kept in them to the end of life. General article.
They who are in the goods of charity. Signified.
Those who are in the goods of charity, and thence in the truths of faith. Signified, Explained.
All those make works meritorious who set the truths of faith in the first place, and the goods of charity in the second; but not they who set the goods of charity in the first place. Explained.
That they who had adjoined some goods of charity to faith, when they saw their destruction, acknowledged the Lord, and were separated. Signified, Explained.

Yet the good of charity is the primary of the Church... Now as the good of charity is from the Lord, and the truth of faith is with a man as from Him, and these two make such a conjunction of the Lord with man and of man with the Lord... it is evident that this conjunction is the Church.
That they should teach the good of charity, and that thus they would gather men. Signified.
Then he feels the good of charity, and perceives the truth of faith...
As, at the last time of the Church, faith... rejects the good of charity. Signified.
But that the good of charity will follow the Lord, and will acknowledge Him, even to the last time of the Old Church and the first of the New. Signified. AE 821:8.
With the spiritual, all power is from the good of charity through the truths of faith...
There is no will of good in those who do not know anything of the good of charity; and they who do not know anything of this good do not know anything about evil...
That the goods of charity are destroyed through falsities, and entirely consumed through evils of every kind thence. Signified.
As in all things of the Church there must be the good of charity... Signified.
The dove Noah sent out = the good of charity, which was the essential of that Church.
That all those are called brethren by the Lord, who acknowledge Him, and are in the good of charity from Him. General article.

The reason the Church is the Church from the good of charity, is that, regarded in itself, this good is the good of life originating from love to the Lord; consequently it is the effect of this love. By the good of charity is meant what is just, sincere, and right in every work and in every function, from the love of what is just, sincere, and right; which love is from the Lord alone.
In the explications in this and the following chapters it treats of the goods of charity.
All the good which a man does to the neighbour for the sake of the neighbour, or for the sake of truth and good... is called the good of charity or good work.
That such as is the Knowledge and the consequent removal of evil through repentance, such is the good of charity. General article.
Therefore genuine truths are to be learned; with these the good of the will conjoins itself, and thus the good of the will becomes the good of charity.
